text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1458-RUB, Spring Loaded Plunger Door Stop Replacement Rubber Bumper

This is a replacement rubber tip fits the Don-Jo 1458 Spring Loaded Plunger Door Stop.

It is held in place with the centered screw. It is very easy to replace. To do so, simply remove the screw to pull the old rubber tip out of the door stop. Then, slide the replacement tip in and attach with the screw you removed. And the best part about the installation is that the plunger door stop does NOT have to be removed from the door to replace the rubber tip.

Specifications for the DJO-1458-RUB Replacement Rubber:

  • Overall Height: 13/16"
  • Top Diameter: 1-1/16"
  • Bottom Diameter: 5/8"
  • Rubber Color: Grey

Warning: These work for Don-Jo 1458 Plunger Stop. If you are not sure if your door stops were manufactured by Don-Jo, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
